t: 苏格兰承认 1 月 1 日而非 3 月 25 日为一年的开始。
te: Scotland recognises January 1 as the start of the year, instead of March 25.
dz: 苏格兰承认 1 月 1 日而非 3 月 25 日为一年的开始。
de: Scotland recognises January 1 as the start of the year, instead of March 25.

t: 在罗马的Campo de' Fiori,哲学家Giordano Bruno在为异端而被活活活烧…
te: On his way to be burned at the stake for heresy, at Campo de' Fiori in Rome, the philosopher Giordano Bruno has a woode…
dz: 在罗马的Campo de' Fiori,哲学家Giordano Bruno在为异端而被活活活烧死途中,他的舌头被放上木头来阻止他继续说话.
de: On his way to be burned at the stake for heresy, at Campo de' Fiori in Rome, the philosopher Giordano Bruno has a wooden vise put on his tongue to prevent him continuing to speak.

t: 秘鲁斯特拉托沃尔卡诺·怀纳普蒂纳在有记录的南美洲历史上最激烈的喷发中爆炸.
te: The Peruvian stratovolcano Huaynaputina explodes in the most violent eruption in the recorded history of South America.
dz: 秘鲁斯特拉托沃尔卡诺·怀纳普蒂纳在有记录的南美洲历史上最激烈的喷发中爆炸.
de: The Peruvian stratovolcano Huaynaputina explodes in the most violent eruption in the recorded history of South America.

t: 在对西吉斯蒙德的战争后(1598–1599年),五名瑞典贵族被公开斩首.
te: The Linköping Bloodbath takes place on Maundy Thursday in Linköping, Sweden: five Swedish noblemen are publicly beheade…
dz: Linköping Bloodbath在瑞典林克平的Maundy星期四举行:在对西吉斯蒙德的战争后(1598–1599年),五名瑞典贵族被公开斩首.
de: The Linköping Bloodbath takes place on Maundy Thursday in Linköping, Sweden: five Swedish noblemen are publicly beheaded in the aftermath of the War against Sigismund (1598–1599).

t: 高丽阴谋对苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世(后成为英格兰国王詹姆斯一世)的阴谋发生在高丽王室(苏格兰珀斯).
te: The Gowrie Conspiracy against King James VI of Scotland (later to become King James I of England) takes place at Gowrie…
dz: 高丽阴谋对苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世(后成为英格兰国王詹姆斯一世)的阴谋发生在高丽王室(苏格兰珀斯).
de: The Gowrie Conspiracy against King James VI of Scotland (later to become King James I of England) takes place at Gowrie House (Perth, Scotland).

t: 德川井上所出之东军击败了忠于丰臣藏也里所出之西日本部族,导致吉福城堡被摧毁并出任了塞克加原之战…
te: The eastern forces of Tokugawa Ieyasu defeat the western Japanese clans loyal to Toyotomi Hideyori, leading to the dest…
dz: 吉福城堡战役:德川井上所出之东军击败了忠于丰臣藏也里所出之西日本部族,导致吉福城堡被摧毁并出任了塞克加原之战的前奏.
de: Battle of Gifu Castle: The eastern forces of Tokugawa Ieyasu defeat the western Japanese clans loyal to Toyotomi Hideyori, leading to the destruction of Gifu Castle and serving as a prelude to the Battle of Sekigahara.

t: 石田三成的西军开始围攻伏见城，鸟居元忠率领的德川驻军规模小得多，但对伏见城的防守却很薄弱。

dz: 石田三成的西军开始围攻伏见城，鸟居元忠率领的德川驻军规模小得多，但对伏见城的防守却很薄弱。
de: Ishida Mitsunari's Western Army commences the Siege of Fushimi Castle, which is lightly defended by a much smaller Tokugawa garrison led by Torii Mototada.

t: 最早幸存下来的歌剧"尤里地斯"(Euridice)获得了其前作表演,从巴洛克时期开始.
te: Euridice, the earliest surviving opera, receives its première performance, beginning the Baroque period.
dz: 最早幸存下来的歌剧"尤里地斯"(Euridice)获得了其前作表演,从巴洛克时期开始.
de: Euridice, the earliest surviving opera, receives its première performance, beginning the Baroque period.

t: 德川龙 义和团在濑原之战中击败了对立的日本部族首领并成为了日本的夏行.
te: Tokugawa Ieyasu defeats the leaders of rival Japanese clans in the Battle of Sekigahara and becomes shōgun of Japan.
dz: 德川龙 义和团在濑原之战中击败了对立的日本部族首领并成为了日本的夏行.
de: Tokugawa Ieyasu defeats the leaders of rival Japanese clans in the Battle of Sekigahara and becomes shōgun of Japan.

t: 英国东印度公司被包租.
te: The British East India Company is chartered.
dz: 英国东印度公司被包租.
de: The British East India Company is chartered.
